bio: Results-driven Product Designer and UX Designer with 2+ years of experience crafting end-to-end digital products across e-commerce, workforce management, and EdTech. Skilled in user research, wireframing, prototyping, information architecture, and developer handoff.

bullets: Independently designed 3 full products end-to-end — an e-commerce platform, a geo-location attendance mobile app, and an EdTech learning app.
Designed complex admin systems including super admin order and transaction management dashboards for data-dense interfaces.
Conducted user research, created personas, and ran usability testing to validate and iterate on product designs.
Collaborated with PMs and developers delivering well-documented Figma handoffs following platform design guidelines.
experience.desc: Independently led full product design cycles at KIBA Labs, from research and wireframes to high-fidelity UI and developer handoff.
